organization: Open Knowledge Foundation Deutschland e.V. / OpenCorporates
license: CC-BY 4.0 per OffeneRegister; OpenSanctions mirror labels it CC-BY-NC 4.0 — confirm before commercial use
data_freshness: stale — coverage mainly 2017-06 to 2019-01 (JSONL last-modified 2019-02-05); a 2022 SQLite snapshot exists separately

fields.meaning: Synthetic OpenCorporates identifier for the German company, combining an internal court id and the register number.
fields.limitations: Synthetic to OpenCorporates — NOT the official register number a user would quote; not stable across other German sources.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary key for this dataset. For cross-source joins prefer the natural key registrar+_registerArt+_registerNummer.

fields.meaning: Registered legal company name including legal-form suffix.
fields.limitations: Legal form is embedded in the string (GmbH/AG/UG/KG…); not a separate code field.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary display name. Derive company_type by parsing the suffix.

fields.meaning: Textual registration status of the company.
fields.limitations: Free text, not a code list; no clean dissolved/active enum and no dissolution date.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to a derived active/dissolved enum heuristically; treat absence as unknown.

fields.meaning: OpenCorporates jurisdiction; always 'de' for this dataset.
fields.limitations: Constant — no sub-jurisdiction detail (federal_state lives in all_attributes).

fields.meaning: Registered postal address as a single free-text string.
fields.limitations: UNPARSED free text — sometimes only a street, sometimes full address with postcode+city. Needs address parsing.
fields.analysis_notes: Parse into street/postcode/city downstream; city often duplicates all_attributes.registered_office.

fields.meaning: ISO8601 timestamp when OpenCorporates scraped the record.
fields.limitations: Mostly 2017–2019 — indicates staleness of the row.

fields.meaning: Array of prior registered company names.
fields.limitations: Only name strings; no validity dates for each previous name.
fields.analysis_notes: Each element is an object with company_name.

fields.meaning: Links to later/renamed/merged registrations of the entity.
fields.limitations: Sparse; structure varies. Captures re-registration after seat/court change.
fields.analysis_notes: Useful to chain register-number changes; keep raw.

fields.meaning: Array of representatives/officers (directors, authorized signatories, board).
fields.limitations: CONTAINS PERSONAL DATA (names, city). Handle under GDPR. See officers[] sub-fields.
fields.analysis_notes: Split into a company_officers table keyed by company_number.

fields.meaning: Full name of the officer (person) or company.
fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA for natural persons.

fields.meaning: Role of the officer.
fields.limitations: Free text role label, not a code list.

fields.meaning: Whether the role holder is a person or a company.
fields.limitations: Mostly 'person'.

fields.meaning: Date the officer's role started.
fields.limitations: Often absent.

fields.meaning: Date the officer's role ended; presence usually implies the officer was dismissed/left.
fields.limitations: Often absent for current officers.

fields.meaning: Officer first name.
fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA.

fields.meaning: Officer last name.
fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA.

fields.meaning: City of residence of the officer.
fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA; not a full address.

fields.meaning: Whether the officer has been removed from the role.
fields.analysis_notes: Use with end_date to compute current vs former officers.

fields.meaning: Representation/signing rule note (Vertretungsregelung).
fields.limitations: Free text.

fields.meaning: Type of register the company is recorded in.
fields.analysis_notes: HRB=Kapitalgesellschaften (GmbH/AG); HRA=Personengesellschaften/sole traders; GnR=cooperatives; VR=associations; PR=partnerships. Part of the natural key.

fields.meaning: Court-scoped register number.
fields.limitations: NOT globally unique — scoped per registering court. Must be combined with registrar + _registerArt.
fields.analysis_notes: With registrar+_registerArt forms the natural key and the EUID-style human reference.

fields.meaning: German-specific register metadata block (native_company_number, federal_state, registered_office, registrar, former_registrar, additional_data document-availability flags).
fields.limitations: Mixed-language values (federal_state in English, registered_office in German). additional_data booleans (AD/CD/HD/DK/SI/UT/VÖ) describe which official documents exist at handelsregister.de, NOT included data.
fields.analysis_notes: registered_office -> municipality; federal_state -> region; registrar -> court; native_company_number -> human-readable reference. SI=structured XML available per document.
